run_scope: H54-C CGRC: whole-segment hide-and-recover holdout (2 configs + exclusion-band diagnostic), lane-safe configuration selection, unique TIF build, format + strict lane validation, power analysis of the 0.0028 detection-floor question. No submission made; no slot selected.
hypothesis: The competition catalogue is a fragmented digitisation (3,118 kept components, median 12 cells, 6,747 degree-1 tips on a 100 m grid). The gaps between facing, strike-compatible catalogue tips (relay/stepover geometries) and the two-sided tangent continuations of segment ends are higher-precision candidates for expert-labelled 'new' faults than the bulk off-catalogue surface covered by the dotted family.
mechanism: CGRC (Catalogue Gap Relay Completion): straight relay lines between tips of different catalogue components (strikes agree <=25 deg, tips face along shared strike, stepover <=500 m, gap 100-2500 m, gap empty of catalogue cells) plus two-sided outward tip tangent continuations <=2500 m (IR-54-021 fix); candidate cells are the 2 px scaffold, excluded from the 200 m catalogue zone; metric-optimal greedy dots at one per 300 m kernel width. Shipped arm B (SGMC-corroborated placement), significantly better than arm A (pure catalogue) on the corrected geometry.
named_non_fault_mimic: Digitisation artefacts and non-fault line work: strands terminating at map-sheet/lithologic contacts (phantom continuations), en-echelon patterns with no linking relay (relay lines cross an empty-but-faultless gap), unrelated facing faults of different age, and pre-Quaternary structures with no geothermal expression (not removed by any gate in this design).
data_provenance: data/grid/labels.tif and data/external/derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif are owner-mirrored, hash-pinned; organizer-origin authentication was not established in this session. The SGMC layer is used only as a placement corroboration weight in the shipped arm (leakage canary clean, AUC 0.52 < 0.90).

verdict_rationale: A unique, format-valid, lane-clean TIF was generated; its surface beats mass-matched random on a self-checked whole-segment holdout (1.50x) and the SGMC-corroborated arm is significantly better than pure catalogue. But the promotion gate 'no slot for an idea that has not beaten the current holdout best' is not met (0.0915 < 0.1793). The catalogue-truth proxy penalizes the off-catalogue mass this method emits, so the holdout is a lower bound, not a fair score of the off-catalogue task. Promotion to a real slot is a separate selector step; the artefact is downloadable and documented either way. Negative results are deliverables.
